Safety Precautions

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, shoes ... etc

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Preparation
Review technical reference material and manufacture's manual
Obtain copy of the setting value of RTD and record at MRDS
Disconnect RTD wires and isolate the wires using tape
Remove RTD from thermowell and take it to lab

items: Review technical reference material and manufacture's manual
Obtain copy of the setting value of RTD and record at MRDS
Disconnect RTD wires and isolate the wires using tape
Remove RTD from thermowell and take it to lab

sections.text: Testing
Put the RTD into the oven
Connect RTD terminals to the ohmmeter

Adjust the oven temperature as stated at the MRDS (from 20C 
to 100C)

Record the readings of the oven temperature and ohmmeter at the 
MRDS

sections.text: Return RTD to Service

Return RTD to service by removing the ohmmeter leads from the RTD 
terminal
Remove TD from oven tester
Return the RTD back to its location
Connect the RTD wires

Place a copy of test result in the 
field maintenance file

sections.text: Automatic Calibration

An RS 232 computer interface supplied as standard allows a 
calibration management software such as INTECAL-W. to provide automatic 
calibration procedures, typically with the following capabilities
Creation of instrument details
Creation of test procedures and work orders
Analysis of devices due for calibration
Printing of calibration reports
Export functions

Parts Identification

rows:
Equalizer block, calibration block with insert
 Protection grid
 Switch test connection, suitable to connect 
 test leads supplied as standard
 Lemo connection for external reference probe: 
 suitable for connecting PT 100 probes with 3 or 4 wires: supplied with 
 standard mating connector (B1, B2 and B3 options)
 Digital display with multi-language user 
 interface
 Tactile keypad for direct selection of all the 
 operating function (ramps, steps, preset values, switch test, help, setup) 
 and to set temperature values
 Cursor (arrow) keys to select operating 
 functions from the main menu and to move the selection cursor through the 
 menus
 RS 232 serial communications interface
 4 mm socket for voltage and current input with 
 24 v dc auxiliary excitation
 4 mm socket for T/C`s, TRD`s and ohm 
 connection, with CJ compensation

sections.text: Calibration

rows:
Using a certified and high accuracy ohms simulator, apply 
the required value to the related electrical connection on the front panel of 
the instrument (the nominal value is the recommended value for the test)

Pressing the ent key will cause the microprocessor to combine the 
resistance measurement on the display (True value and effective reading)
